title: gompholobium villosum
intro: Gompholobium villosum, commonly known as the hairy pea-flower, is a flowering plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gompholobium villosum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
